name: Butcher
description: Cutscenes for Hypixel SkyBlock's rare drops: the Scatha, Vanguard corpses, Diana's Mythological Ritual, the Inferno Demonlord, lava fishing, the Fishing Festival's Great White Shark and the Dwarven Mines' Ghosts. The drop is hidden until the reveal; you keep control while it plays. /butcher opens the settings.
